retrieval_notes: Raw curl -sL response bodies are saved without editing as transcripts/evidence/hkjc-20261101/results-race-<race>.html and results-race-<race>-guru.html. fetched_at is each output file's modification time in UTC, truncated to seconds.

HKJC redirects the requested LocalResults.aspx URLs to /en-us/local/information/localresults with the same RaceDate, Racecourse and RaceNo parameters. Both official pages contain completed placings, finish times, full-field Win Odds and paid WIN dividends.

The favourite is determined from the minimum final Win Odds across all 10 finishers in race 7 and all 12 finishers in race 8 in HKJC's performance table, not from the winner's dividend. Each race has a unique favourite and a single first-place finisher.

Both guru responses remain pre-race cards marked EventScheduled and state that the race has not been run yet. They are retained and hashed as retrieval evidence only; no verdict or final odds are taken from them. The official HKJC completed results are the resolution source.
